blocks.text: Understanding the Philippines goes beyond reaching its destinations. It means discovering the traditions, stories, and cultural influences that shape Filipino identity, and one of the best ways to understand these is through food. Recognizing gastronomy as a gateway to cultural discovery, 2GO Travel and FEATR officially launched Taste of the Philippines, an immersive culinary and cultural experience that brings participants closer to the country’s heritage through regional cuisines, local food communities, and the people behind them.
